q: Ziv-Lempel complexity (used in LZ77/LZ78 compression) is related to entropy by the fact that:
opts: It equals H exactly for all sequences
The LZ complexity rate converges to H for stationary ergodic sources
It is always less than H
exp: Ziv-Lempel theorem: for ergodic stationary sources, the compression ratio of the LZ algorithm converges a.s. to the entropy rate H. This makes LZ-based algorithms asymptotically optimal.
